title: Investment Update: High Yielders
summary: Income stocks, China policy, and crypto selectivity.
coverage_note: Complete source read including all macro/China sections, digital assets, Altria, Realty Income, EPD, Chevron and closing valuation argument. Quoted 2022 altcoin thesis remains a repeated family. Market-implied rate cuts are distinguished from the author explicit skepticism.

framework_lessons: Compare net interest exposure before forecasting cuts.
assessment: The skeptical rate-cut view and subsequent dollar rebound were concrete strengths. Realty Income dividend growth and price-floor tests and EPD threshold/payout calls are supported. China stimulus arrived promptly, but inferred motives and decade analogies remain unverified. Relative crypto/high-yield theses need careful universes and horizons; tobacco migration and producer profitability should not erase declining volumes or weaker earnings.
verification_limitations: Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
